topography.project_purpose: Smilee Finance is a DeFi protocol offering options and liquid staking products. It enables users to trade options and earn yield through liquid staking derivatives across Arbitrum and Berachain.
topography.relationship_narrative: The two families operate on separate chains with no direct contract dependencies, but share the Smilee Finance brand and likely a common governance or token layer not visible in the contract surface.
